description:
## Problem (ISS-010 + ISS-016 + ISS-012-marker, live-confirmed 2026-07-01 — repro: note N-001)
(1) A resumed review in deliberate mode silently returns a single-provider result with NO deliberation block and no marker (deliberation.ts:292, :322 fall through to failover). (2) Degraded results claim agreement:'agree' (deliberation.ts:188, :208). (3) runAdjudicate swallows cross-review failures into undefined adjudications (deliberation.ts:251 `if (!res.ok) return out;`) — indistinguishable from "not adjudicated". (4) No result in ANY mode says which mode/providers actually ran — root of the "deliberation silently didn't run" dogfooding failure.

## Fix — five parts, one coherent change
**A. Per-call toggle.** Add `deliberate?: boolean` to PlanReviewInput and CodeReviewInput (src/backends/backend.ts). MCP: add `deliberate: z.boolean().optional()` to review_plan + review_code inputSchemas (review-code passes {...args, diff} so it flows automatically; verify review-plan does the same). CLI: `--deliberate` / `--no-deliberate` Commander options on review-plan and review-code (src/cli/commands.ts), threaded into the input object. NOT on precommit (stays failover-only; say so in its tool description).
Effective-mode resolution (implement exactly): input.deliberate===true → 'deliberate-deep' if config.mode==='deliberate-deep' else 'deliberate'; input.deliberate===false → 'failover'; undefined → config mode. In config mode 'single' with input.deliberate===true → return err INVALID_INPUT explaining mode is single and deliberation needs a second provider (do NOT silently ignore).
**B. Unified composite.** Replace the failover/deliberation split in createBackend (src/backends/index.ts:56-58) with ONE composite factory (suggest src/backends/composite.ts) built from both leaves + config + the T-027 lookupSessionProvider, choosing per call: resumed input → T-027 ownership routing; effective mode deliberate* → deliberation flow; else → withFailover. Keep the existing pure functions (computeAgreement, combineCode/Plan, degradeCode/Plan, withFailover) exported and reused — do not rewrite them, recompose them. Existing failover.test.ts / deliberation.test.ts must keep passing (update factory wiring only).
**C. Mode stamping.** Add `review_mode: z.enum(['single','failover','deliberate','deliberate-deep']).optional()` to PlanReviewResultSchema, CodeReviewResultSchema AND PrecommitResultSchema (src/review/types.ts, additive). The composite stamps the EFFECTIVE mode that ran (degraded deliberation still stamps 'deliberate'/'deliberate-deep' — the degraded marker carries the caveat; precommit under a composite stamps 'failover'). For config mode 'single', wrap the leaf in a thin decorator in createBackend that stamps 'single' on success results. After this, absence of a deliberation block is always interpretable.
**D. Deliberate-on-resume (the real ISS-010 fix — requires T-027).** When effective mode is deliberate* and input.session_id is set: the OWNING leaf resumes (session continuity), the other leaf reviews FRESH (same input minus session_id; model rule: input.model goes only to the primary leaf, strip for secondary — existing convention). Combined result's session_id = the RESUMED session's id (NOT unconditionally ra.session_id — combineCode/Plan need a sessionId parameter or post-fix). provider field stays primary. If the non-owner fails → existing degrade path. If the owner fails → degrade to the fresh non-owner result BUT session_id then belongs to a NEW session; that is correct (old session unusable this round) — add a unit test locking this.
**E. Honest markers (ISS-016 + ISS-012-marker).** (i) Degraded results: agreement gets new enum value 'degraded' (extend the agreement enum in deliberationSchema, src/review/types.ts:63) — set it in degradeCode/degradePlan instead of 'agree'. (ii) chunks_reviewed: extend the verdicts entries to { provider, verdict, chunks_reviewed? } and set top-level chunks_reviewed = the primary's value when present (combineCode :124-141). (iii) Cross-review failures: change runAdjudicate to return { adjudications, failure?: { by, reason } } instead of swallowing (deliberation.ts:234-258); surface as optional `cross_review_failures: [{ by, reason }]` array on the deliberation block (both judges can fail independently). Chunking of the cross-review subject itself is T-030, not here.

## Docs
Update README (mode table + per-call toggle + result fields) and the MCP tool descriptions (server instructions block) in the same commit series.

## Acceptance
(a) Probe N-001 step 3 inverted: resumed review in deliberate mode now returns a deliberation block with both providers (or degraded marker), and review_mode on every result in every mode incl. single + precommit. (b) Per-call deliberate=true on a failover-config produces a deliberation block; deliberate=false on a deliberate-config produces failover with review_mode:'failover'. (c) deliberate=true under single-mode config → structured INVALID_INPUT. (d) Degraded result has agreement:'degraded'. (e) Unit tests: mock leaves only (prod-realistic rule); every new schema field validated via the Zod schemas. (f) Full gate green. Resolve ISS-010 + ISS-016; update ISS-012 (marker half done, chunking remains → T-030).

## House rules
TDD; ESM .js suffixes; no `any`/`as`; Result<T>; additive-only schema changes; config layer must not import review layer; no AI names in commits.
title: Deliberation visibility: per-call toggle, mode in every result, honest markers (ISS-010, ISS-016, ISS-012-marker)
